:::{#exm-distribution-model-family}
#### Normal distribution models with polynomial mean functions

The normal distribution models of @exm-distribution-model
whose mean function $\modmem$ is a polynomial of degree at most $\polydeg$,
with any variance $\varpar > 0$,
form a [distribution model family](#def-distribution-model-family) $\distfam$.
By @eq-normal-distribution-model-mean-function,
the set of mean functions in @eq-distribution-model-family-mean-functions
is the set of polynomials of degree at most $\polydeg$ of @exm-model-family.

:::
